replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: 1) Standardize data. 2) Compute covariance matrix. 3) Eigen-decompose → sort eigenvalues. 4) Retain top *k* components (reduce dimensionality). No need for anxiety—it’s systematic, like factor analysis in stats.
